theorem Tengoku.BezoutCounterexampleLean.kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcdUpToUnits [IsDomain R] [IsBezout R] [GCDMonoid R] :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔ KaplanskyConditionGCDUpToUnits R

name: Tengoku.BezoutCounterexampleLean.kaplanskyCondition_iff_primitive_matrix
statement:
theorem Tengoku.BezoutCounterexampleLean.kaplanskyCondition_iff_primitive_matrix [IsBezout R] [IsCancelMulZero R] :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔
      ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R, Matrix.entryIdeal M = ⊤ →
        ∃ p q s t : R, ![p, q] ᵥ* M ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] = 1

name: Tengoku.BezoutCounterexampleLean.not_kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.BezoutCounterexampleLean.not_kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] :
    ¬ KaplanskyConditionGCD R ↔
      ∃ a b c : R, gcd a (gcd b c) = 1 ∧
        ∀ p q : R, gcd (p * a) (p * b + q * c) ≠ 1

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjOn.trans

    (hg : IsMonotoneSurjOn g K' K) (hf : IsMonotoneSurjOn f K'' K') :
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (g ∘ f) K'' K

statement:
lemma mulVec_two_vecMulVec (c s : ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) • Matrix.vecMulVec ![c, s] ![c, s]).mulVec u =
      (2 * (c * u 0 + s * u 1)) • ![c, s]

name: BezoutCounterexample.not_isOrientable_comp

theorem not_isOrientable_comp {K' K : Type*} [TopologicalSpace K'] [TopologicalSpace K]
    [CompactSpace K'] [T2Space K] {q : K' → K} (hq : IsMonotoneSurjection q)
    (X Y : K → ℝ) (hX : Continuous X) (hY : Continuous Y) (hXY : ∀ z, X z ^ 2 + Y z ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : ¬ IsOrientable X Y) : ¬ IsOrientable (X ∘ q) (Y ∘ q)

name: BezoutCounterexample.not_isOrientable_pullback
statement:
theorem not_isOrientable_pullback {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (a b : A) {K : Set (RealPt A)} {K' : Set (RealPt B)} (hK' : IsCompact K')
    (hmono : IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap f) K' K) (hcirc : ∀ z ∈ K, z a ^ 2 + z b ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : ¬ IsOrientable (fun z : K => z.1 a) (fun z : K => z.1 b)) :
    ¬ IsOrientable (fun z : K' => z.1 (f a)) (fun z : K' => z.1 (f b))
